newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks leap in early morning on NY gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks leap in early morning on NY gains.

text.p: Tokyo stocks leapt in early Wednesday morning trade, extending the previous day's gains, brokers said. They said that the market was being helped along by Wall Street's climb to another record high overnight, brokers said.
By 0020 GMT, the shares were up 85.05 points or 0.41 percent to 21,041.23. Its December futures were up 90 points to 21,080.
"Wall Street continues to be strong and the Tokyo market is appreciating it," one broker with a second-tier brokerage said.
